notes: «وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter at the first level; «جدته أم أبيه» is one relation with no name (his grandmother, the mother of his father), and she is the last link as the one whose account carries the Prophet's words.

fixes.reason: The K6I index lists only two of the transmitters the text gives; it omits Rafi' b. Salama, Hashraj and the grandmother.

evidence.quote: حدثني حشرج بن زياد، عن جدته أم أبيه
زيد بن الحباب أبو الحسين العكلي
